mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.user_no, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.user_type, u.cert_entity_id, u.cert_id, ifnull(u.buss_id, u.user_name) buss_id, u.buss_name, u.eps_name, ifnull(d.tenant_id, -1) tenant_id, d.sub_code, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

SELECT t1.role_id, GROUP_CONCAT(t.user_id) userId, GROUP_CONCAT(t.nick_name) userName FROM sys_user t LEFT JOIN sys_user_role t1 on t1.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.STATUS = '0' AND t1.role_id = #{roleId} and exists(select 1 from sys_dept td where td.del_flag = '0' and td.dept_id = t.dept_id and td.dept_id = #{epsId}) GROUP BY t1.role_id

SELECT t1.role_id, t.user_id userId, t.nick_name userName FROM sys_user t LEFT JOIN sys_user_role t1 on t1.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role t3 on t1.role_id = t3.role_id and t3.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.STATUS = '0' AND t3.role_key = #{roleKey}
